climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Chardonnay sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.

blurb.text: The best-known part of the Mâconnais, a white wine appellation made only from Chardonnay in Fuissé, Solutré-Pouilly, Vergisson and Chaintré. It gained premier cru status in 2020, with 22 premier cru climats.
